title_en: Wang Ping — Commutation of Sentence for Meritorious Service During Labor Reform
keywords_en: Criminal; Commutation of Sentence; First Instance; Intermediate People's Court; Shaanxi Province; Natural Person; Criminal Law; Determination of Meritorious Performance; Extent of Commutation; Reversal of Judgment; Rape of Minor Female; Meritorious Service while Serving Sentence; Reporting Robbery; Robbery
full_text_en:
Wang Ping — Sentence Reduction for Meritorious Service During Reformation Through Labor

Criminal Wang Ping, male, 26 years old (born February 3, 1959), native of Gai County, Liaoning Province. Formerly a worker at Baoji Bridge Factory, currently serving a sentence in the No. 10 Reformation Through Labor Detachment of Shaanxi Province.

In the autumn of 1976, Criminal Wang Ping successively lured five young girls to his home and raped them, with the rape of two young girls being attempted but not completed. He was arrested on September 26, 1983. On December 28, 1983, the Weibin District People's Court of Baoji, Shaanxi Province, after trial, found that: Wang Ping raped multiple young girls, committing the crime of raping young girls under Article 139, Paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, and the circumstances were especially serious, warranting severe punishment under Paragraph 3 of the same article. However, because Wang Ping was under 18 years old at the time of the crime, a lighter punishment should be imposed pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law. Accordingly, Wang Ping was sentenced to 15 years of fixed-term imprisonment.

During his sentence reform through labor, Wang Ping accepted his guilt and submitted to the law, behaving satisfactorily. In January 1985, after education by the reform officer, Wang Ping reported to the reform officer a robbery case involving four persons in partnership. Upon investigation by the public security authorities, Wang Ping's report was confirmed to be true, and the four criminals were arrested and brought to justice. Because Wang Ping had demonstrated meritorious service during his sentence, the reform-through-labor authority submitted a proposal for his sentence reduction on January 25, 1985, requesting review by the Baoji Intermediate People's Court. The Baoji Intermediate People's Court, after trial, found that: Wang Ping's report of robbery by others was true, and he indeed had meritorious service. Pursuant to Article 71 of the Criminal Law of the PRC, it ruled to reduce Wang Ping's sentence by five years.

At its 226th meeting on June 5, 1985, the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the PRC, after summarizing trial experience, held that: in trial work, the people's courts correctly implement the law and the policy of differential treatment, granting sentence reductions according to law to criminals with meritorious service who are currently serving sentences, and imposing heavier or enhanced punishments according to law on criminals who escape or commit new crimes during their sentences, which is conducive to promoting criminals' reform and self-renewal. The ruling of the Baoji Intermediate People's Court to reduce Wang Ping's sentence by five years applied the law correctly and reflected the policy.
